title: Reaper Cultist - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Reaper Cultist in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Dark is the only element that lands. Its Chromatic form drops Blodam.

sections.title: Where to Find the Reaper Cultist
How to Beat the Reaper Cultist
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Dark is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.
